answer: Each agent can earn spending credits only by completing a task that a randomly selected, already-established counterparty verifies, with payment released from escrow after matching evidence is checked. New identities have no history, so splitting one attacker into a hundred accounts does not create a hundred trusted verifiers; they must recruit real counterparties or slowly build separate records. That costs fees, time, and scarce human cooperation. An echo of a fable in pigment may decorate a profile, but it cannot substitute for verified work.
